name: Example Employee ID SD-JWT TYPE METADATA
description: Example Employee ID SD-JWT Verifiable Credential Type Metadata, based on ietf-oauth-sd-jwt-vc (draft 13), using a single language tag (en-US). Custom Yubico corporate-badge-style credential, not part of the eudi-wallet PID/mDL/Diploma/EHIC family.
$comment: New in Slice A of the YubiId VC wallet integration effort (see docs/integration/04-integration-design.md). Modeled on vctm_pid_arf_1_8.json's structure/format.

display.label: Employee ID
display.description: Unique identifier assigned to the employee by the issuing organization.

display.label: Department
display.description: Organizational department the employee belongs to.

display.label: Photo
display.description: Base64-encoded photo of the employee, same convention as PID's picture claim.

display.label: Issue date
display.description: Date the Employee ID credential was issued.
